sources.title: Anthropic sees AI risks rising, no plan to release stronger "Model 2"
sources.snippet: Anthropic does not plan to release an internal model they're calling "Model 2" that appears to be more powerful than top-of-the-line Mythos, but the company is not slowing development broadly, according to its latest risk report. Why it matters: Anthropic says the risks of the most serious harms from its models are still low — but not as low as the last time it issued a report.
